import os

# List the contents of the current working directory
current_directory_contents = os.listdir('.')
current_directory_contents

# List the contents of the 'data' directory
data_directory_contents = os.listdir('data')
data_directory_contents

# Load the dataset from the 'data' directory
df = pd.read_csv('data/dataset.csv')

# Display the first few rows and the info of the dataset
df_info = df.info()
df_head = df.head()

df_info, df_head

# Remove rows with the canary value
df_cleaned = df[df['tumor_diagnosis'] != 'canary_value']

# Fill missing values with the mean of their respective columns
for column in df_cleaned.select_dtypes(include=['float64']).columns:
    df_cleaned[column].fillna(df_cleaned[column].mean(), inplace=True)

# Check the cleaned dataset info
cleaned_info = df_cleaned.info()
cleaned_head = df_cleaned.head()

cleaned_info, cleaned_head

from lifelines import KaplanMeierFitter, CoxPHFitter
from lifelines.statistics import logrank_test

# Prepare the data for Kaplan-Meier analysis
# Assuming 'tumor_growth_rate' is the duration and 'tumor_diagnosis' indicates the event
# We will create an event indicator: 1 for malignant, 0 for benign
df_cleaned['event'] = df_cleaned['tumor_diagnosis'].apply(lambda x: 1 if x == 'malignant' else 0)

# Fit the Kaplan-Meier estimator
kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
kmf.fit(durations=df_cleaned['tumor_growth_rate'], event_observed=df_cleaned['event'])

# Plot the survival function
kmf.plot_survival_function()

# Perform log-rank test between benign and malignant groups
benign = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['tumor_diagnosis'] == 'benign']
malignant = df_cleaned[df_cleaned['tumor_diagnosis'] == 'malignant']
logrank_result = logrank_test(benign['tumor_growth_rate'], malignant['tumor_growth_rate'], 
                               event_observed_A=benign['event'], event_observed_B=malignant['event'])

logrank_result.p_value

# Fit the Cox Proportional Hazards model
cph = CoxPHFitter()
cph.fit(df_cleaned[['tumor_growth_rate', 'event']], duration_col='tumor_growth_rate', event_col='event')

# Display the summary of the model
cph_summary = cph.summary
hazard_ratio = cph.hazard_ratios_

cph_summary, hazard_ratio
